# Blip (heyblip.au)

> Blip is a free iOS app for chatting at festivals, sporting events, ultra marathons, concerts, and other crowded events where mobile reception fails. Messages hop phone-to-phone over Bluetooth Low Energy mesh, so no Wi-Fi, cellular data, or infrastructure is required. Built in Australia.

Key facts:
- Works with zero signal: messages relay phone-to-phone via BLE mesh
- Direct messages are end-to-end encrypted (Noise XX + Ed25519) and private groups use AES-256-GCM sender keys; relay phones cannot read them. Public event channels are signed, not encrypted
- Emergency SOS broadcast reaches every nearby Blip phone at priority (it does not call emergency services)
- Group chats, encrypted DMs, voice notes, push-to-talk, photos
- Find friends nearby and a friend map, all without internet
- No phone number required; location sharing is off until you switch it on, and shared positions are signed, unencrypted broadcasts that nearby Blip phones can read and that, when a phone has internet, our relay forwards to every Blip phone connected to it
- iOS (iPhone) only; free download

## Features

- [Chat](https://heyblip.au/features/chat): Group chat, end-to-end encrypted direct messages, and voice push-to-talk with no internet or signal
- [Safety & SOS](https://heyblip.au/features/safety): Emergency SOS broadcast and medical assistance over mesh when networks are down
- [Events](https://heyblip.au/features/events): Event discovery, schedules, and live updates that work offline on site
- [Nearby & Friends](https://heyblip.au/features/nearby): Find your friends at a festival with no reception — nearby list, friend map, meeting points
- [Profile](https://heyblip.au/features/profile): Profiles without a phone number, friend adding, and privacy controls

## Docs

- [How Blip works — technical specs](https://heyblip.au/tech): BLE 5.0 mesh, Noise XX encrypted direct messages with Ed25519 packet signing, adaptive gossip routing, 7-hop TTL
- [Download](https://heyblip.au/download): Get Blip for iPhone
- [For event organisers](https://heyblip.au/organisers): Mesh comms for event safety and operations teams
- [Support](https://heyblip.au/support): Help and contact
- [Privacy](https://heyblip.au/privacy)
